$ edit testdata/script/loop.txtar  # a case that states a property only b registers
$ edit testdata/script/gapped.txtar  # a gaps line naming b's column, whose cell now differs
$ FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./b  # pkg-b-circular
    script/gapped: shout prints A1 wrongly, a known gap in b's cell.
        shout: Does what the case's shout/ tree says.
        The cell is frozen by its known gap, gaps line 1: "shout A1 is SIX. Waits on sheets#15."
        Its committed files record today's behavior, and the run now produces different ones:
        out/shout/values.txt differs (-committed +got):
        - A1 SIX
        + A1 SEVEN
        If the gap is closed, remove the line. If the wrong behavior changed shape, delete the cell's files.
--- FAIL: TestCorpus
    --- FAIL: TestCorpus/script
        --- FAIL: TestCorpus/script/gapped
            --- FAIL: TestCorpus/script/gapped/shout
        --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/loop
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/loop/shout
        --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice/shout
FAIL
[exit 1]
$ cat testdata/script/gapped.txtar
shout prints A1 wrongly, a known gap in b's cell.
-- in/do/out/values.txt --
A1 6
-- in/shout/out/values.txt --
A1 SEVEN
-- gaps --
shout A1 is SIX. Waits on sheets#15.
-- out/echo/inputs --
values.txt
  in/do/out/values.txt
-- out/echo/outcome --
accepted
-- out/echo/values.txt --
A1 6
-- out/shout/outcome --
accepted
-- out/shout/values.txt --
A1 SIX
$ go test  # pkg-a
--- PASS: TestCorpus
    --- PASS: TestCorpus/script
        --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/gapped
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/gapped/echo
        --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/loop
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/loop/echo
        --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice/echo
PASS
$ go test ./b  # pkg-b-circular

        + A1 SEVEN
